text:
rachel: quick heads up  noticed a few inbound leads landed in overflow this morning but routing shows enrichment succeeded. digging in, looks like a contact merge in HubSpot changed external_id after enrichment and SF mapping failed.

dev: interesting  so enrichment returned owner but the external_id on the contact got remapped to a different HubSpot id afterward? that would break our idempotent assign check.

eric: yep. sequence I see: 1) routing claims contact hs:123 (owner A), 2) enrichment returns owner=A for hs:123, 3) HubSpot de-dupe merges hs:123 into hs:987 and rewrites external_id -> hs:987, 4) reconciliation step looks up by external_id, finds no match for hs:123 and marks unowned -> fallback to overflow.
mona: ugh. that merge event is async and can happen after enrichment. we should handle merges by accepting enrichment owner if enrichment included original_external_id or a list of previous_ids.

dev: do we get prior IDs in webhook? HubSpot sometimes sends merge info: 

```json
{"event":"contact_merge","primary":"hs:987","secondary":"hs:123","timestamp":1680000000}
```
If we see a recent merge for the contact within X seconds of enrichment, we can map enrichment.owner -> primary id.

eric: alternatively, change our assign flow to attempt an assign by email if external_id lookup fails. safer: fallback order when assigning after enrichment: 1) try external_id, 2) try email, 3) try phone. and only fallback to overflow if all fail.

mona: email-based assign is noisy because reps sometimes use personal emails. but for merged contacts it should be reliable if enrichment returned the email. add guard: only use email assign when enrichment.confidence > 0.7.

rachel: ops plan:
- patch routing to accept merge events and maintain a 60s merge-cache mapping old->new ids
- change assign lookup to email fallback with confidence guard
- instrument metrics: merge_hit_rate, assign_by_email_count, overflow_post_enrich_count
- canary: enable on import routes for 3% traffic for 12h

dev: small sketch of merge-cache behavior: when webhook:contact_merge arrives, write map secondary->primary with TTL 120s. when assign fails by external_id, consult cache and retry with mapped id.

eric: also add a safe-retry: if external_id lookup fails but enrichment returned owner and enrichment_source == "hs_enrich_v3", do a non-destructive lookup by email before marking unowned. log reassign_attempts.

hs-bot: hubspot: contact_merge event received primary=hs:987 secondary=hs:123 ts=1680000105

mona: runbook update for support: if rep reports missing lead -> check for contact_merge events near enrichment timestamp, check assign_by_email logs, and check overflow_post_enrich metric. manual fix: reassign via SF by searching email if mapping lost.
rachel: PR incoming. dev will add merge cache + email-fallback. i'll own dashboard and alerts (goal: overflow_post_enrich_count -> 0 for canary cohort).
dev: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/lead-routing/pull/1120 (draft)
rachel: starting canary at 05:00 UTC for 12h. will post snapshots at 3h and 12h. :eyes:
